annotation: Source-review reference fixed before either retrieval arm was scored. The historical follow-up ledger was used to seed an independent review of byte-verified PDFs at physical page numbers. The selected pages explain the project's time, identity, tenements, footprint, sampled subarea or exclusion. They are a non-exhaustive reference; unlisted pages remain unjudged. Spatial geometry decisions require non-PDF data as well. Each latitude/longitude pair shares one location search and one evidence assessment. Prior use of the reports in the Census means this is not an independently annotated never-before-seen corpus.
